events.title: Kimberly Akimbo

events.summary: Carol Seigel leads an approximately 90-minute walk starting and finishing at Burgh House. £10 paid at the start; reserve by email using the Society’s instructions.

events.title: Up//Roar Live London Launch
events.summary: Free, ticketed queer-poetry launch with readings and music, 19:00–21:00. Nightingale Room at the library next door to Keats House; ages 16+. Optional book purchases are not admission tickets.

events.title: Up//Roar online poetry launch
events.summary: Free ticketed online readings, 15:00–17:00; ages 16+. Admission is separate from optional book add-ons.

events.title: AI safety and antitrust: UCL international webinar
events.summary: Free webinar examining AI safety coordination and competition law, 14:00–16:30 BST. Advance Zoom registration essential.

events.title: 40 Objects, 40 Years
events.summary: Anniversary exhibition included in museum admission; adult £14.90 without donation. Wednesday–Sunday 10:30–17:00. Upstairs with no step-free access; drop-ins welcome. Session hours: 10:30–17:00.

events.title: Monday Hampstead Heath health walks
events.venue: Parliament Hill Café / Hampstead Heath entrance opposite Overground
events.summary: Free, no booking. Gentle walk meets at Parliament Hill Café, finishing 11:00; longer walk meets opposite Hampstead Heath Overground, finishing around midday. Both start 10:00; arrive five minutes early.

events.title: Thursday Hampstead Heath health walk
events.summary: Free medium-length health walk; meet volunteer leaders at Parliament Hill Café. No booking; arrive five minutes early. Expected finish 12:30. Session hours: 11:00–12:30.

events.title: National Gallery weekday guided tours
events.summary: Free drop-in tours Tuesday 6, Wednesday 7 and Thursday 8 October, 15:00–16:00 each day. First come, first served; individuals and groups of up to four. Arrive early. Session hours: 15:00–16:00.
